meta.description: Reach OrthoAppeals Medicaid coverage directory: per state, the official Medicaid coverage-policy/provider-manual entry point and how prior authorization works. Medicaid ortho surgery (e.g., TKA 27447) is generally covered as medically necessary; most states delegate the criteria to MCOs (InterQual/MCG) or a state FFS manual — so this is a per-STATE entry point, not per-procedure criteria.
meta.caveat: Unlike the commercial directory, Medicaid rarely publishes procedure-specific public policies; coverage is medical-necessity + PA via the state FFS manual or the member's managed-care plan. The URL is the authoritative starting point; the live agent should confirm the member's specific plan (FFS vs a named MCO).

Alabama.prior_auth_basis: FFS: medically necessary per Physician program rules; PA for select procedures; AL largely FFS
Alabama.notes: Provider Billing Manual Ch.28 Physician; PA page 7.7_Prior_Authorization.

Alaska.prior_auth_basis: FFS: medical necessity; service authorization required for surgical/inpatient (Conduent/Gainwell)
Alaska.notes: Mostly FFS; detail in Provider Billing Manuals.

Arizona.prior_auth_basis: Mostly MCO-administered (UM criteria); FFS uses AMPM Ch.800/820 PA
Arizona.notes: AMPM is master policy; most members in ACC managed care.

Arkansas.prior_auth_basis: FFS: medical necessity; PA/UR via AFMC; PASSE managed care for some

California.prior_auth_basis: FFS via Treatment Authorization Request (TAR); most in managed care using InterQual/MCG
California.notes: DHCS Provider Manual; majority in managed care plans.

Colorado.prior_auth_basis: FFS: medical necessity; PA via ColoradoPAR (Acentra) using state criteria + InterQual
Colorado.notes: Physical health largely FFS with RAEs coordinating.

Connecticut.prior_auth_basis: Self-insured FFS (ASO by CHNCT); medical necessity, PA per HUSKY clinical policies
Connecticut.notes: Single FFS model, no full-risk medical MCOs.

Delaware.prior_auth_basis: Mostly MCO (AmeriHealth Caritas DE, Highmark) using InterQual/MCG; DMMA policy manual
Delaware.notes: Diamond State Health Plan mostly MCO-administered.

Florida.prior_auth_basis: Orthopedic Services Coverage Policy (Rule 59G-4.211); PA per 59G-1.053; SMMC plans administer PA
Florida.notes: Dedicated Orthopedic Services Coverage Policy exists.

Georgia.prior_auth_basis: FFS: medical necessity; prior approval (DMA-610) for select surgery; CMOs run own PA
Georgia.notes: Part II Physician Services manual via GAMMIS; most in Georgia Families CMOs.

Hawaii.prior_auth_basis: FFS PA per provider manual; QUEST Integration MCOs use InterQual/MCG

Idaho.prior_auth_basis: FFS PA per state criteria; surgery PA form (Telligen/Gainwell UR)
Idaho.notes: Largely FFS; handbook Medical/Hospital modules at idmedicaid.com.

Illinois.prior_auth_basis: FFS PA per HFS Medical Prior Approval Criteria (MPAC); MCOs use InterQual/MCG
Illinois.notes: Practitioner Handbook Ch.A-200; most in HealthChoice MCOs.

Indiana.program_name: IHCP (HIP / Hoosier Healthwise / Hoosier Care Connect)
Indiana.prior_auth_basis: FFS PA per IHCP criteria; MCEs use InterQual/MCG

Iowa.prior_auth_basis: FFS PA per Iowa Medicaid criteria; MCOs (Iowa Total Care, Wellpoint) use InterQual/MCG

Kansas.prior_auth_basis: FFS PA per KMAP manual; KanCare MCOs use InterQual/MCG
Kansas.notes: Nearly all in KanCare MCOs (Aetna, Sunflower, Healthy Blue).

Kentucky.prior_auth_basis: FFS PA per DMS criteria (KYHealth Net e-PA); MCOs use InterQual/MCG

Louisiana.prior_auth_basis: FFS PA per LDH provider-manual (PC-PM); Healthy Louisiana MCOs use InterQual/MCG

Maine.prior_auth_basis: FFS PA per MaineCare Benefits Manual (UR via Kepro/Acentra)
Maine.notes: Primarily FFS; MBM Ch.II Section 90 Physician / 45 Hospital.

Maryland.prior_auth_basis: FFS PA per state criteria; HealthChoice MCOs use InterQual/MCG

Massachusetts.prior_auth_basis: FFS PA per 130 CMR + medical-necessity guidelines; ACOs/MCOs use InterQual/MCG
Massachusetts.notes: Some ortho items (e.g., knee arthroscopy) have specific PA.

Michigan.prior_auth_basis: FFS PA per Provider Manual/FFS criteria; Medicaid Health Plans use InterQual/MCG

Minnesota.prior_auth_basis: FFS authorization per MHCP Provider Manual (Acentra); MCOs use own criteria
Minnesota.notes: Prepaid Medical Assistance MCOs administer PA.

Mississippi.prior_auth_basis: FFS PA via Telligen per Admin Code; MississippiCAN MCOs use InterQual/MCG
Mississippi.notes: Procedure-code PA list; Title 23 Admin Code.

Missouri.prior_auth_basis: FFS PA per Physician manual medical necessity; Managed Care plans run own PA

Montana.prior_auth_basis: Primarily FFS; PA per provider manuals + Admin Rules of Montana
Montana.notes: Largely FFS (Passport PCCM); surgery-facility manuals exist.

Nebraska.prior_auth_basis: FFS PA per 471 NAC (Gainwell); Heritage Health MCOs use InterQual/MCG
Nebraska.notes: Criteria/forms at nebraska.fhsc.com; most in MCOs.

Nevada.prior_auth_basis: FFS PA per Medicaid Services Manual (Ch.600 Physician; Gainwell); MCOs use InterQual/MCG

New Hampshire.prior_auth_basis: FFS PA per General Billing manuals + He-W rules; MCM MCOs use InterQual/MCG
New Hampshire.notes: Manuals on nhmmis.nh.gov; most in Medicaid Care Management MCOs.

New Jersey.prior_auth_basis: FFS PA per manuals + N.J.A.C. Title 10; NJ FamilyCare MCOs use InterQual/MCG

New Mexico.prior_auth_basis: Mostly MCO (Turquoise Care) using InterQual/MCG; FFS PA per MAD criteria
New Mexico.notes: MAD Managed Care Policy Manual + 8.302 NMAC.

New York.prior_auth_basis: FFS: prior approval per eMedNY Physician Manual; MCOs use own UM criteria

North Carolina.prior_auth_basis: FFS PA per NC Clinical Coverage Policies (1A surgical series); PHPs/Tailored Plans
North Carolina.notes: Numbered Clinical Coverage Policies; much of pop in managed care.

North Dakota.prior_auth_basis: FFS service authorization per ND Billing and Policy Manual; medical necessity

Ohio.prior_auth_basis: FFS PA per ODM; Next Generation MCOs use InterQual/MCG
Ohio.notes: Most in Next Generation managed care.

Oklahoma.prior_auth_basis: FFS PA per OAC Title 317; SoonerSelect MCOs administer PA
Oklahoma.notes: SoonerSelect MCOs now cover most members.

Oregon.prior_auth_basis: Coverage by HERC Prioritized List line; PA to OHA (FFS) or member's CCO
Oregon.notes: Major joint surgery on covered lines; most in CCOs.

Pennsylvania.prior_auth_basis: FFS PA per PROMISe handbooks + 55 Pa Code Ch.1101/1150; HealthChoices MCOs administer PA

Rhode Island.prior_auth_basis: FFS PA per EOHHS Provider Manual; MCOs administer PA

South Carolina.prior_auth_basis: FFS PA per SCDHHS Physicians Services Manual; MCOs use InterQual/MCG
South Carolina.notes: Most in Healthy Connections managed care.

South Dakota.prior_auth_basis: FFS: medical necessity per SD Billing and Policy Manual; PA per state criteria

Tennessee.prior_auth_basis: ~100% managed care; MCCs administer PA (InterQual/MCG) + TennCare rules
Tennessee.notes: No central FFS medical policy; delegated to MCCs.

Texas.prior_auth_basis: FFS PA via TMHP per TMPPM (PA chapter 1.05); STAR MCOs use InterQual/MCG
Texas.notes: TMHP is claims/PA administrator; most in STAR.

Utah.prior_auth_basis: FFS PA per Utah Medicaid coverage criteria; ACOs apply own criteria
Utah.notes: Physician Services Provider Manual defines covered surgery.

Vermont.prior_auth_basis: Primarily FFS; PA per DVHA Clinical Coverage Guidelines

Virginia.prior_auth_basis: FFS service authorization per DMAS manuals; Cardinal Care MCOs use InterQual/MCG
Virginia.notes: Practitioner manual Ch.IV; most in Cardinal Care MCOs.

Washington.prior_auth_basis: FFS PA per HCA billing guides + WAC; Apple Health MCOs use InterQual/MCG

West Virginia.prior_auth_basis: FFS per BMS Ch.519 Practitioner Services (519.16 Surgical); MCOs apply own criteria
West Virginia.notes: Dedicated Surgical Services policy; most in Mountain Health Trust.

Wisconsin.prior_auth_basis: FFS PA per ForwardHealth Online Handbook; HMOs apply own criteria

Wyoming.prior_auth_basis: FFS PA via Telligen (state UM/QIO) per state/InterQual criteria; medical necessity
